halves.name: Golden Retriever
halves.desc: You love out loud. Warm, gentle and all in, you decide for yourself what closeness looks like, and nobody around you ever wonders if they're wanted.

axes.line: Your people are your happy place. Close means shared: plans, snacks, calendars.
You hold the person first. The hard part waits for a gentler moment.
You write your own script for love, home and holidays.

halves.name: The Easygoer
halves.desc: You don't race anyone's timeline. You go with the flow, you like the flow familiar, and you're usually the calmest person in the room.

axes.line: Security first. Your leaps come with a safety net.
You run on your own clock. Other people's timelines are optional.
You read the room. Rules bend when a person needs them to.

stings: You make room for everyone's feelings in real time. Yours tend to come up a week later, casually.
People mistake your calm for not caring. You just haven't found the thing worth rushing for yet.
hearts: I'd rather love too much than too carefully.
My life doesn't need a progress bar.

tags.name: Bends rules for people
tags.heart: I look at the person, not the form.
tags.sting: You make exceptions for everyone you care about, and keeping track of them all is its own job.

youToldGenii.said: Never. At our table, house rules beat the book.
"Done. Biscuit and I go way back."
"Wrong number!" Then call my friend on the walk home.

tags.name: Logs off on time
tags.heart: A good life is the whole point, not the reward for later.
tags.sting: You've turned down a bigger role and slept great. Some people still can't figure you out.

youToldGenii.said: Never. I stop counting on purpose. Freedom.
Didn't touch it. Future me handled it.
Never. My free time costs more than they pay.

tags.name: Makes my own traditions
tags.heart: No script is the gift I gave myself.
tags.sting: You skipped the script, which means every choice at home is yours to make, and to explain.

youToldGenii.said: Wrong. Stopped going. Started my own.
Came exactly as I am. Sneakers, no rehearsed lines.
Celebrated a holiday or birthday my own way, not the usual way

tags.name: Lets it go
tags.heart: Leaving gently is still a way of caring.
tags.sting: You leave before it gets messy. Now and then, that's before it gets good.

youToldGenii.said: Let it fade. Fewer texts, then none.
Just stopped going. Nobody asked. I didn't explain.
Cancel the booking. Some friendships end for a reason.

tags.name: Saves first, spends later
tags.heart: Being ready is how I relax.
tags.sting: You've saved for a rainy day so long that the sunny days sometimes go unspent.

youToldGenii.said: Guilty. Two hiding spots. One is a decoy.
Checked the numbers. Stayed home. Watched the photos.
"$200. Friendship price. Not a cent more."

calls.line: You've said 'technically' and then done the nice thing anyway.
You'll leave on time today and not think about work or school once.
Your future home will have at least one tradition you invented.

plotTwist.line: You'd say: ‘Crush it. Finding out is the fun part.’ Last time, you did: ‘Something booked more than six months from now’
